analysis:
Both supplied units (SSDPrefixCache.swift head lines 1-1255) were examined. They contain no changed lines: the complete range map shows the only changes at head 1790-1794 and 1799-1800, which are outside these units. Those changed lines add an optional `unusedSince: Int64?` parameter to retireOwnedEntries/retireIndexedEntries and pass it to SSDOwnedEntryRetirement.remove. The default is nil, so existing callers keep their behavior.

Unchanged context relevant to T-041 was reviewed:
- lookup stays RAM-only, with salt-scoped HMAC tags (lines 533-542) and ticket pinning (559-575).
- endAdoption releases the per-entry reservation (lines 616-651).
- close releases the per-entry reservations (lines 430-462).
- The donation gate is adoption bound + benefit floor (lines 883-888). The persisted-run cap is at lines 938-947.
- DBK3 metadata carries only keyed lookupTag, weightHash, layoutEpoch and similar fields (lines 1057-1065). Sidecar metadata adds windowBaseTag, an HMAC commitment (lines 1220-1232).

I found no regression in the visible scope. The unusedSince parameter appears intended to make removal conditional on an entry being unused since a timestamp, likely an LRU/TTL race guard. Integration should check two things:
- SSDOwnedEntryRetirement.remove semantics, in another file: does a non-nil unusedSince only ever skip deletion of recently touched entries, without broadening deletion or bypassing removalLock/hasSafeRoot/ownsEvictionRoot?
- Callers passing unusedSince, likely SSDDiskBudget or the sweeper: does it preserve the T-041 30-minute TTL bound, i.e. expired entries are still eventually removed, so the at-rest window does not silently extend?

Neither the implementation nor these callers is in the supplied evidence.
